faq.q: Can you rent a boat in Marbella in December?
faq.a: Yes, boat rentals in Marbella run year-round. December is quieter, so you get more choice and often better availability. Most boats depart from Puerto Banús, and you can book a 2-hour, 4-hour, or full-day charter. Just bring a warm layer for the sea breeze.

faq.q: What is the sea temperature in Marbella in December?
faq.a: The Mediterranean off Marbella averages 15-16°C in December. That's too cold for swimming without a wetsuit for most people, but you can still enjoy the coastline, spotting beaches and coves from the deck. If you do want a dip, a short shock-swim is possible.

faq.q: Is December a good time for a boat trip in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, if you prefer calm, peaceful conditions. December sees fewer crowds, lower prices on some boats, and often clear, sunny days. The main risks are wind and rain, so check the forecast and choose a morning slot when winds are typically lighter.

faq.q: What should I wear on a boat in Marbella in December?
faq.a: Layers are key: a thermal base, a fleece, and a waterproof windbreaker. The sun can still be warm at midday, but the sea breeze is chilly. Bring sunglasses, a hat, and non-slip shoes. The boat provides blankets and shelter, but you'll appreciate a warm jacket.

faq.q: Which boats are available for a December charter?
faq.a: All our fleet is available in December, from the 8m Dubhe (5 pax) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax). For small groups, the Mariah SX21 or Speedboat are ideal. For luxury, the Mangusta 80 or Canados 86 offer heated interiors and flybridges.

faq.q: Do you provide heating on board?
faq.a: Most of our larger yachts (Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, Canados 86) have interior heating, so you can warm up between deck views. Smaller open boats don't have heating, but we provide blankets on request. Let us know when booking and we'll prepare.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on my booking day?
faq.a: Safety first. If the forecast shows high winds or rough seas, we'll reschedule your charter to a better day or offer a full refund. We monitor conditions closely and will contact you 24-48 hours before departure if there's a risk.

faq.q: Are there any special December offers?
faq.a: Yes, winter bookings often come with more flexible pricing. For example, our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are available from €749/2h, and Tier B Mangusta 80 from €4,719/4h. For other boats, message us on WhatsApp for a custom quote.

data.body_html:
Thinking about a Marbella boat rental in December? You might be surprised to learn that the Costa del Sol's winter sea is far from empty. With air temperatures around 16°C and sea temperatures holding at 15-16°C, December offers a crisp, clear perspective of the coastline — and far fewer boats on the water than in July. The key is knowing what weather to expect and which boat suits the season. Here's your practical guide to the Marbella boat rental weather in December.

December Weather in Marbella: What to Expect

December in Marbella is mild but variable. Average daytime highs reach 16-17°C, with overnight lows around 8-10°C. The sea temperature is a brisk 15-16°C — swimmable only for the brave, but perfect for cruising. Expect around 5-6 hours of sunshine per day, with occasional rain (usually 6-8 days in the month). Winds are typically 10-15 knots, but mornings are often calmer, making a 10:00 or 11:00 departure the smartest choice.

Why Rent a Boat in December?

Winter charters offer a unique experience: you'll have the Mediterranean's most glamorous coastline almost to yourself. The light is golden, the mountains (including La Concha) are snow-capped, and the views of Puerto Banús from the water are postcard-perfect. Plus, you'll avoid summer crowds at beaches like Cabopino and Cala del Faro. And with lower demand, you may find better availability on premium yachts like the Mangusta 80.

Which Boats Are Best for December?

For winter, consider a boat with protection from the elements. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) has a heated saloon and a partially enclosed flybridge. The Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offers true luxury with indoor and outdoor lounges. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) has a cabin for shelter. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

What to See on a Winter Cruise

December cruising is all about scenic views, not swimming. Head east from Puerto Banús towards Cabopino and Cala Cortés, where the cliffs and coves are dramatic in winter light. Or cruise west to Estepona and Sotogrande, passing the Golden Mile and the dunes of Artola. Keep an eye out for dolphins — they're often more visible in winter when the water is clearer. For a shorter trip, a 2-hour cruise along the Marbella shoreline is perfect.

Pricing for December Charters

Our December boat rental pricing is the same as year-round. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are available from €749 for 2 hours, or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day (skipper, drinks, and VAT included). The Mangusta 80 (and its grey sister ship) starts at €4,719 for a 4-hour charter, which includes a free jet ski. For other boats like the Pershing 46 or Lagoon 380, contact us on WhatsApp for a tailored quote.

How to Prepare for a December Boat Trip

  • Dress in layers: thermal base, fleece, waterproof jacket.
  • Bring a beanie and gloves — the wind can be biting.
  • Book a morning slot (10:00-14:00) for calmer seas.
  • Check the marine forecast 24h before departure.
  • Let us know if you'd like extra blankets on board.
